title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-05-03
source: SBD/PA Reel: TASCAM 22-2 modified for flat transfer. Reel-> Tascam 22-2 -> Tascam MKII DR-07 (24-bit, 96kHz) - DC8Forensics for editing and modification

ai_review.summary: Excellent fixed audience tape of an early show featuring a stellar Other One and standout He Was a Friend of Mine and Doing That Rag.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this early‑era concert, highlighting the powerful Other One and their favorite takes on He Was a Friend of Mine and Doing That Rag. The fixed AUD source has been cleaned up nicely, delivering clear and enjoyable sound that lets the performance shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings, praising both the musical performance and the restored audience recording; consistent high praise yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fixed AUD source – cleaned up from an early tape, crisp and clear for an audience recording, no noted drop‑outs or major issues.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑era set flows smoothly with classic folk/rock numbers; the highlighted tracks stand out as high points.
